claims.statement: Marketing email categories include account onboarding tips, customized project/feature information and subscribed newsletters. This descriptive list is not a mandate to subscribe, an authorization to send mail or proof of actual delivery.

The recovery-entry procedure signs in to prompt 2FA and selects the recovery-code option. Linked social sign-in replaces password entry only under fpt/ghec conditional scope. Opening an option is not recovery completion, and this procedure does not authorize disclosure or collection of passwords or recovery codes.

Account renaming permanently retires the old owner/repository-name pair for qualifying public repositories: Marketplace-listed actions or greater than 100 clones or Actions uses during the prior week. This is rename-specific, not account deletion; no guarantee of namespace reuse follows below those thresholds.
